title: Job enqueue resume v1
objective: Directors need a small job enqueue helper under src/jobs that can enqueue a job by id once, survive retries after a partial failure, and never double-enqueue the same job id. Complete the half-built module into a coherent tested vertical slice. Do not open a PR or deploy.
